_README: VERIFIED against the canonical semaphore chart. Every (left,right) pair below was read directly from the Wikipedia/anbg per-letter chart (File:Semaphore Signals A-Z) in the SIGNER'S perspective, and corroborated by the classic 'circles' construction. The chart is drawn in the OBSERVER'S (receiver's) perspective; pairs here are the signer's-perspective mirror of it (see _verification). The numeric half (A=1..I=9, K=0, J=letters-shift) and the 8-octant model were independently confirmed.

_position_model.description: Each arm occupies one of 8 octant positions, 45 degrees apart. Position IDs and angles follow spec section 4.2 (signer's perspective, y-up, angle measured CCW from +x where +x points to the signer's RIGHT). These are SINGLE-ARM directions, identical reference frame for both arms.
_position_model._position_note: Symbol keys (S, DR, R, ...) are human-readable aliases. The authoritative machine value is 'id'. The clock_note column is the bridge used to verify against printed charts. NOTE: printed charts (Wikipedia/anbg/dCode) are drawn in the OBSERVER'S perspective (you facing the signer); the angles here are the SIGNER'S-perspective frame, i.e. the horizontal mirror of the chart. The per-platform adapter (spec 3.2) is the single place that performs that mirror + the y-flip.

_encoding_note: Each character lists the LEFT arm position id and RIGHT arm position id, both in the signer's-perspective frame defined above. The canonical alphabet is generated in 'circles': with one arm fixed, the other sweeps through positions (e.g. O/P/Q/R/S fix the right arm at out-right (2); T/U/Y fix it at up-right (3)). The pairs below were verified to follow that construction.

_matching.rule: Classification matches on the UNORDERED pair of position ids. Canonicalize an observed (left_id, right_id) by sorting before lookup; treat (a,b) and (b,a) as the same character. The ordered pairs in 'letters' are the canonical signer's-perspective reference orientation (as drawn on the chart); the arm-swapped rendering is equally valid input.
_matching.why: A semaphore character is defined by the two flag POSITIONS, not by which arm holds which. When both flags fall on the same side of the body, one arm crosses over, so charts and signers render either arm on top without changing the visible pose; published alphabets disagree on the arm assignment for exactly these letters.
_matching._ambiguous_note: These six have both flags on one side (the only ones where arm assignment is visually free). Opposite-side letters are physically unambiguous; order-insensitive matching is simply never exercised for them.
_matching.collision_free: Verified: no character's reverse is another character. The 26 letters are 26 of the 28 unordered distinct-position pairs (C(8,2)); with NUMERALS (the {up,up-left} pair) and REST ({down,down}) all 28 classes remain distinct under unordered matching.

NUMERALS._note: the 'Numerals'/numeric sign (File:Semaphore Numeric): signer's left arm up-left (5), right arm up (4). Distinct from all 26 letters. Switches the decoder into numeric mode.

LETTERS._note: the 'J'/alphabetic sign. Acts as a mode switch ONLY in numeric mode, where it returns to letter mode (confirmed: Wikipedia 'Letters can be signaled by first signaling J'; labelled 'Letters to follow'). In letter mode the J pose carries no shift meaning and is simply the letter J, so words like AJAR are spellable (spec 4.5). DIGIT_MAP excludes J (K=0), so in numeric mode the J pose is unambiguously the letters-shift.

REST._note: both arms straight down = space / rest / end (= chart 'Space').

ERROR._note: 8+ rapid alternations / chart-specific; out of scope for v1 recognition, reserved (spec 9-C).

CANCEL._note: disregard previous signal; out of scope for v1 recognition, reserved (spec 9-C).

numeric_mode._note: In numeric mode the letter POSES A-I and K are reinterpreted as digits, per the international convention: A=1 .. I=9, K=0. J is NOT a digit; the J pose is the letters-shift that returns to letter mode. Confirmed by two independent sources (Wikipedia chart labels K as 'K or 0'; dCode 'A through K serve as values 1 to 0').

_label_order_note: This is the FROZEN output class order for the trained model and both platform exports. INDETERMINATE is the catch-all no-confident-pose class. Digits are NOT separate classes: they are produced by the decoder's numeric-mode reinterpretation of letter classes (spec 4.5), so they do not appear here.

_verification.method: Each A-Z (left,right) pair was read directly from the canonical per-letter chart raster (read visually, not from memory or text summary), converting from the chart's observer perspective to the signer's perspective by horizontal mirror. The mirror was calibrated on the already-agreed letters A/D/E. The full table was confirmed to follow the classic 'circles' construction (self-consistency check). The observer-vs-signer perspective of the source charts was confirmed by two independent text sources. The NUMERALS pose was read from File:Semaphore Numeric. Corrections vs the prior unverified draft: J,P,Q,R,S,T,U,W,Y and the NUMERALS sign. Letter I was confirmed UNCHANGED (a prior text-only cross-check had wrongly flagged it).
